purpose: Accounting decomposition of the same 475 executed positions, not a simulation of different trading costs or exits.
native_source: Original A/B report.htm deal tables, matched in/out sequentially after asserting no overlapping positions and matching recorded times, direction, volume, entry/exit price, net cash and initial money risk.
components: price_profit + entry/exit commission + entry/exit swap = net cash; each component divided by the original execution_initial_risk_money gives additive R components.
extra_descriptions: Nonzero swap count, negative swap burden and positive swap credits
Count of price-profit positive but whole-position net negative outcomes
limitations: Price-profit component still includes spread and slippage in the executed prices.
No separate deal fee field in native HTML; all-in match to EA net cash is asserted.
Applied commissions/swaps are what this tester charged, not independently verified historical 2020 broker schedules.
No new entry-hour split, parameter search, alternative-cost backtest or removal of positions.
